run_finetune_t5: run the T5 seq2seq fine-tuning script with argparse to train on KILT datasets
create_seq2seq_transformer: create a Seq2seqTransformer model instance with special tokens and dataset-specific batch sizes
test_model_predictions: test the fine-tuned T5 model by loading the latest checkpoint and running predictions
build_dataloader: build a concatenated DataLoader for training, validation, or test splits across multiple KILT datasets
review_validation_step: review the validation_step method that generates predictions using beam search and computes exact match
